definitions.explanation: Describes the color yellow. This is one of the most common color adjectives in Japanese. Unlike many colors that are na-adjectives, きいろい is an i-adjective.

examples.japanese: {黄色|きいろ}い{花|はな}がたくさん{咲|さ}いています。
このバナナは{黄色|きいろ}くなりました。
{黄色|きいろ}い{傘|かさ}を{持|も}っています。
{黄色|きいろ}いタクシーは{目立|めだ}つので、{見|み}つけやすいです。
examples.english: Yellow taxis stand out, so they're easy to find.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると、{葉|は}っぱが{黄色|きいろ}くなって、とても{きれい|きれい}です。
examples.english: In autumn, the leaves turn yellow and are very beautiful.

notes: きいろい is one of the basic color terms in Japanese. The noun form is {黄色|きいろ} (kiiro). Unlike many color words that are na-adjectives (like {緑|みどり}), きいろい is an i-adjective. Yellow is associated with caution in Japan, similar to Western cultures (yellow traffic lights, warning signs).
